tool_input.command: $p='src/styles/base.css'; $c=Get-Content $p -Raw; $c=$c.Replace(".site-footer {`n  border-top: var(--border-width-hairline) solid var(--color-border-subtle);`n}`n`n.site-footer-inner {`n", ".site-footer-inner {`n  border-top: var(--border-width-hairline) solid var(--color-border-subtle);`n"); $c=$c.Replace(".closing {`n", ".closing span {`n  white-space: nowrap;`n}`n`n.closing {`n"); Set-Content $p $c -NoNewline; Select-String -Path $p -Pattern 'site-footer-inner \{' -Context 0,2; Select-String -Path $p -Pattern 'closing span'
tool_input.description: Move footer hairline and add closing nowrap rule

tool_input.command: for m in "" "--mobile"; do node pigment-snap.mjs --measure /about ".bp-fig" ".bp-row figcaption" ".closing" $m 2>&1 | grep -E '^\.|^  \{' | sed -E 's/"padding.*"font"/ "font"/; s/"color".*//'; done
